user.title: Xfinity
user.description: Enter the service address and the refresh token printed by get_token.py on a desktop computer. Home Assistant stores that token and renews it. It does not open a browser.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh Xfinity token
reauth_confirm.description: The saved refresh token was rejected. Run get_token.py on a desktop and paste the new refresh token.

reconfigure.title: Xfinity address
reconfigure.description: Update the service address used for outage checks.

error.invalid_client: Xfinity rejected this integration's app credential. Update the integration.
error.invalid_address: Enter a street address between 5 and 200 characters.
error.invalid_token: Paste the refresh token with no spaces or line breaks.

invalid_client.title: Xfinity needs an integration update
invalid_client.description: Xfinity rejected this integration's application credential. Update the Xfinity integration. Pasting a new refresh token will not fix this.
